retirementReason: Worst 0.42 below correction floor; full spheres on narrow frusta triggered the forbidden lollipop cluster archetype.
constructionRule: All visible vertical macro masses above the low plinth must be closed 6- or 8-sided tapered frusta or closed dome volumes, never rectangular/chamfered box walls. Adjacent volumes must deeply overlap in footprint and Y range. Sink each full-sphere dome into its closed drum so only a dome cap reads above the collar.
requiredHierarchy: one wide elliptical faceted lower cathedral frustum
two faceted transept shoulder frusta overlapping the lower cathedral
two overlapping faceted central keep frusta
exactly four two-stage tapered satellite tower frusta deeply fused into the body
one source-scale hero dome and four subordinate dome caps visibly buried into their drums
one small faceted lantern and buried crown cap
forbidden: full ball visibly perched on a tower
micro-detail used to hide failed massing
